issues.reason: The split is real (one substance ends up under both the bare constant mist_light and a fresh sk_mist_light_1, so producing and attracting do not chain), but calling it a parse defect overstates it: Existential bars the bare class symbol "for a specific definite individual", so the definite "the mist-light" could not reuse mist_light, and every emitted atom is true and well-typed.

Names and casing directs that a name's kind be stated in one ordinary type atom "whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it" (the Kestrel River -> (Member kestrel_river river)), and Core patterns licenses a type atom off "a kind word inside the name itself", so (Member middle_row row) is owed and its absence makes two otherwise identical names (Cliff Path, Middle Row) parse differently.

gaps_confirmed: a non-deictic season anchored to a stated year ("in the late summer of Year 1"): Time enumerates the structured terms Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute and lists seasons only as speech-anchored deictic constants (last_spring, next_summer), so no form is specified for a season of a named year and late_summer is invented
new_gaps: a definite NP whose only antecedent was introduced as a bare mass/kind constant ("the lantern produced mist-light" ... "The mist-light attracted nightmoths"): the specific definite must be a typed witness, but nothing licensed links that witness back to the earlier bare-constant mention, so one substance is recorded under two unrelated symbols; a licensed form would need an identity/portion link between a kind-filler mention and a later definite witness of the same stuff

"stay / remain + locative PP" when a reification trigger is present ("All the sky-cats stayed on the cliff-spires that night"): the time modifier licenses the reified Experiencer+Location state, but the continuative force of "stayed" still has no carrier there (the prompt itself registers the no-carrier note for the bare position route), so the rule is indistinguishable from "all the sky-cats were on the cliff-spires that night"
defect_summary: Add the ordinary type atom (Member middle_row row) beside (Name middle_row "Middle Row") — the kind word sitting inside the name licenses and requires it, exactly as this same parse's (Member cliff_path path) does for "the Cliff Path".
notes: I do not count the reviewer's second gap: "at the third watch" is covered by Time's rule that a deictic or named (non-calendar) time stays a bare symbol and composes with calendar terms, so third_watch is licensed rather than improvised. The rest of the parse holds up — the BeforeBy equinox gap, "that night" term propagation, the seventeen/handful count encodings, and the all-the-sky-cats per-member rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion.
